narrative.details:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your lack of incompetence, you shall be rewarded with punishing those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--adventurer, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
narrative.offerRewardText: There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.
